raw_text: Satellite Images Show India Building Military Infrastructure Along Disputed LAC. Commercial satellite imagery appears to show India constructing bunker complexes and artillery positions in sectors along the Line of Actual Control that are subject to bilateral agreements restricting military construction. The imagery, analyzed by Chinese defence think tanks, suggests India may be altering the status quo along the contested border. China's Ministry of National Defence has not yet commented on the development.
clean_text: South China Morning Post reported on satellite imagery allegedly showing Indian military construction along LAC. Imagery analyzed by Chinese defence think tanks. Later found to contain manipulated elements.
